description: Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos (1993 Westwood CD, via DOSBox-X)
long: Lands of Lore: The Throne of Chaos is a first-person grid-based role-playing game in the tradition of Eye of the Beholder. Players lead a party against the shape-shifting witch Scotia, exploring dungeons, solving puzzles and battling monsters in real time. It features digitized character portraits and a voice cameo by Patrick Stewart as King Richard.
